defects.title: Stock returns did not accumulate prior returns or duplicate lines against the original qty
defects.evidence: scripts/verifyFixStockReturnCumulative.ts; stockReturnGuard; PG FOR UPDATE inside postStockDocumentAtomic
defects.fix: Sum original lines, prior POSTED returns by referenceId, and current request per itemId; reject when exceeding remaining; validate return type vs original.

defects.title: Reversing a custody expense voucher restores the custody balance twice
defects.evidence: scripts/verifyFixP1Custody.ts; single restore in reverseCustodyExpenseVoucher only
defects.fix: Removed service-level updateCashCustody after journal; adapters remain sole restore path.

defects.title: Supplier invoice approval is wrong under the default stock-accounting config (autoPostEnabled=false)
defects.evidence: scripts/verifyFixP1P2pAutopost.ts; approveSupplierInvoice Dr Inventory when autoPostEnabled=false, Dr GR/IR when true (code on tree)
defects.fix: Invoice approval reads autoPostEnabled; false => debit item/default inventory accounts instead of GR/IR.

defects.title: The application database role may bypass RLS
defects.evidence: INFO: DB role bypasses RLS = true in evidence/standards-intelligence/battery-output-f2-pg.txt. Guide: docs/ops/PROD-PG-ROLE.md; probe: scripts/verifySec4ProdRole.ts.
defects.fix: Use a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS application role and set AN_ENFORCE_PROD_ROLE=1 in production.

knownRisks: PostgreSQL gates (verify*Pg.ts) need DATABASE_URL; they print PG_NOT_RUN without it and prove nothing then.
Behind a proxy, confirm the real client IP reaches the app (set TRUST_PROXY, or rely on K_SERVICE on Cloud Run).
Internal battery endpoints (/api/internal/*) are limited to developer/auditor roles; keep them off public production roles.
Maintainability: server.ts is about 5,150 lines, PostgresPrimaryAdapter about 9,400 lines, roughly 1,800 uses of `any`.

ops.tests: npm test (runs scripts/runReconcileAuditB.ts: every non-PG gate with expected counts; refreshes these docs)

env.TRUST_PROXY: hops or subnet list; K_SERVICE implies 1 hop
env.AN_ENFORCE_PROD_ROLE: 1 = fail when the DB role bypasses RLS
env.EXPOSE_ERROR_DETAILS: 1 = return raw error messages (local debugging only)
